children: RNS Number : 8372T  Wellnex Life Limited  08 September 2026

Wellnex Life Limited (ASX/AIM: WNX) ("Wellnex Life" or the "Company") advises in accordance with ASX Listing Rule 3.13.2 and section 251AA of the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth), details of the results and proxies received in respect of the resolution tabled at its 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting ("EGM").
The resolution set out in the Notice of EGM and Explanatory Memorandum dated 7 August 2026, was duly carried by poll.
For full details of the voting result, please refer to the attached table of results.
This ASX/AIM announcement has been authorised by the Board of Wellnex Life Limited (ASX/AIM:WNX).
